admin.hook_decision.appeal_only.defaultMessage: A refused local post is not cancelled here. Its author can appeal it, and overturning the appeal cancels the decision.
admin.hook_decision.appeal_only.description: Shown in the cancellation region of a refusal of a local post: it goes through the author's appeal instead.

admin.hook_decision.back.description: Link from a decision's page back to the list of decisions.

admin.hook_decision.cancel.description.defaultMessage: Cancelling takes effect at once and undoes what the review did where it can.
admin.hook_decision.cancel.description.description: Hint above the button that cancels a decision on its page.

admin.hook_decision.cancel.title.description: Heading of the region of a decision's page where a moderator cancels it.

admin.hook_decision.cancelled.description: Shown in the cancellation region of a decision that is cancelled; the facts above say when.

admin.hook_decision.facts.title.description: Heading of the region of a decision's page with what the review decided and on what.

admin.hook_decision.no_effect.defaultMessage: This decision had no effect, so there is nothing to cancel.
admin.hook_decision.no_effect.description: Shown in the cancellation region of a decision made in observe mode or that failed: there is no button.

admin.hook_decision.title.description: Heading of the page of one decision of an external review.
